items.headline: Ex-Broncos exec John Beake, who helped land John Elway, dies at 87
items.body: John Beake, who was instrumental in the trade for John Elway and helped guide the Denver Broncos to back-to-back Super Bowl titles in the late 1990s, has died at age 87, the team said Saturday.

items.headline: 49ers rule out Bosa for Monday, still hopeful for Evans, Juszczyk
items.body: The San Francisco 49ers will have to wait at least another week for the return of defensive end Nick Bosa, though there's at least a chance they'll have both receiver Mike Evans and fullback Kyle Juszczyk for Monday's game vs. the Washington Commanders.

items.headline: Bears start QB Caleb Williams in Week 6 against Falcons
items.body: The Bears will start Caleb Williams on Sunday against the Falcons after the star quarterback missed the past three games due to a torn hamstring.

items.headline: Eagles QB Jalen Hurts on IR due to blood clot, expected to be out indefinitely
items.body: The Eagles have placed Jalen Hurts on injured reserve after consultations with numerous doctors and experts, sources told ESPN and NFL Network.

items.headline: Steelers place Wilson on IR with finger injury
items.body: The Pittsburgh Steelers placed Roman Wilson on the injured reserve list, their second key receiver lost to injury in as many weeks.

items.headline: Taylor Moton among 3 Panthers activated ahead of Eagles game
items.body: The Panthers will have RT Taylor Moton and DE Tershawn Wharton available Sunday against the Eagles. RB Trevor Etienne was also activated off IR.

items.headline: Bears CB Kyler Gordon set for 2026 debut after PUP activation
items.body: Bears nickel corner Kyler Gordon has been activated off the PUP list and could make his season debut against the Falcons.

items.headline: Commanders RB Jacory Croskey-Merritt out vs. 49ers with groin injury
items.body: Commanders running back Jacory Croskey-Merritt won't play against the 49ers because of a groin injury, coach Dan Quinn said.

items.headline: Patriots activate WR A.J. Brown for Sunday's game vs. Jets
items.body: Patriots wide receiver A.J. Brown was activated from injured reserve Saturday after missing the past four games with a right high ankle sprain, the team announced.

items.headline: Jags unlikely to play 3 international games in 2027 during EverBank renovations
items.body: The Jaguars are unlikely to play three international home games in 2027 while renovations to EverBank Stadium continue, team president Mark Lamping said.

items.headline: Eagles' Saquon Barkley ruled out; DeVonta Smith likely to return
items.body: Eagles RB Saquon Barkley has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Panthers with a hamstring injury, but it appears WR DeVonta Smith will return.

items.headline: Broncos' Jonathon Cooper off commissioner exempt list, could return Week 7
items.body: Broncos linebacker Jonathon Cooper was removed from the commissioner exempt list Friday, meaning he's available to play in Week 7. Cooper, who was arrested twice in a seven-day span in June on domestic violence charges, has been on the list since Aug. 30.

items.headline: Packers' Josh Jacobs eligible to return next week amid investigation
items.body: Packers RB Josh Jacobs will be removed from the commissioner exempt list Monday, the league announced, making him eligible to practice and play next week.

items.headline: Bears' Caleb Williams questionable after 3 days of practice
items.body: The quarterback said there are several hurdles to clear before he would be able to face the Falcons on Sunday.

items.headline: Cardinals 'do what's right,' rule RB Jeremiyah Love (ankle) out vs. Rams
items.body: The Cardinals say they're doing "what's right" for RB Jeremiyah Love by ruling the prized rookie out for Sunday's game against the Rams due to his injured left ankle.

items.headline: Jalen Hurts' health bigger than football, as teammates, coach detail QB concern
items.body: Eagles coach Nick Sirianni declined to offer much detail about Jalen Hurts' health, instead focusing on his connection with the quarterback.

items.headline: Seahawks sticking with Sam Darnold as starter despite INTs
items.body: Seahawks coach Mike Macdonald is standing behind Sam Darnold as the team's starting quarterback despite his seven interceptions over the past four games.

items.headline: Chiefs WR Rashee Rice out Sunday vs. Chargers with hamstring injury

items.headline: Pettine ready to lend support, experience to Cowboys' defense
items.body: Mike Pettine was traveling through Italy, celebrating his 60th birthday when he got a call from Cowboys defensive coordinator Christian Parker a few weeks ago seeing if he would take a role on the staff.
